A '''hoyy seed''' was a type of edible [[Seed/Legends|seed]] that could be consumed by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as well as other sentient beings. They were served at [[Ithor Delicacies]], a food stand that operated on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']].<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" /> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], offered hoyy seeds for an additional [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] as an add-on for its [[herd ship's bounty salad]]s, the diner's take on the traditional Ithorian [[covado salad]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hoyy seeds were first mentioned in "[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]," a [[1991]] adventure supplement written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] for [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]].<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" />
